question: How should one purify the intellect across the range from the paisaca level to Virinca?
premises: From the paisaca level up to Virinca there are powers such as anima.
One should understand this range clearly.
The intellect should be purified together with the eight of the city and the senses.
inference: Contemplative knowledge of this entire range enables purification of the intellect along with the subtle body and senses.
uncertainties: The exact constituents of the puryaṣṭaka are assumed from standard doctrine rather than stated here.
plain_english: Knowing thus that powers like anima operate in this range from the paisaca level up to Virinca, one should purify the intellect together with the eight constituents of the subtle city and the senses.
